column1: # The resolver of the instance's box: INSTANCE_ID, BOX_ID, machine-id, hostname → the box and the source or a refusal (the contract instance.md sources, box; INSTANCE130-SOURCES-01). The form — README.

column4: an empty INSTANCE_ID — as not set: the box is computed
an empty BOX_ID — as not set → machine-id
BOX_ID set not by the box grammar — a start refusal, code 2: what is set is not substituted
trimming SP, TAB, CR, LF at both ends
a read error → hostname, the same trimming
not by the box grammar → hostname
hostname not by the grammar — a start refusal, code 2 «no box name»
hostname empty after trimming — a start refusal, code 2 «no box name»
